meaning: Bridge (#401), a transcription (invariant 16): stage 1 of the case (STMT-GOD-EXISTS, there is a God in the case signature) is the resurrection pilot's existence cell (STMT-PILOT-GOD-EXISTS) for any pilot state whose core signature it is.
